channel.title: Making of Iltonggi
channel.description: How Iltonggi is being made — one short note a day.

item.title: Four Kingdoms, Four Colors, Still Distinct at Night
item.description: How we picked colors for Goguryeo, Baekje, Silla and Gaya in Iltonggi, measured whether they stay distinct day and night, and added hanja chips and shapes too.

item.title: A Three Kingdoms Land Grab for Your Phone
item.description: Why we're building Iltonggi, a Three Kingdoms land-grab game for your phone: 5-10 minute rounds, autosave, a short first game, and no daily log-in pressure.
